[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1072_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="Logos"]我明白。
[charslot]
[dialog]
[Blocker(a=0.6, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="你看见Logos冰冷的侧脸，以及顺应他的话语，服从地自他舌尖显现的咒文。", x=300,y=270,  alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n但是——你没有看见萨卢斯的恐惧，癫狂，或是，任何一种将死之人的情绪。",block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n你只看见了，她兴趣盎然。",block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1")]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_653_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="萨卢斯"]喔，这就是如今的女妖之主？“王庭丧钟”？确实了得，这些咒文的精细程度不亚于你的英雄母亲。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_653_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="萨卢斯"]可，你知道吗？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_653_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="萨卢斯"]这样精巧的符文——精巧的源石技艺，绝非萨卡兹最本初的心态。
[dialog]
[Blocker(a=0.6, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="她在后退。", x=300,y=270,  alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n她的身后正上方是——",block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n一具女妖的雕像。",block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1")]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[delay(time=1)]
[stopmusic(fadetime=2)]
[bgeffect(name="$eb_dim_openeye",layer=1)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_land_impact", volume=0.3)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_enchntrescram_1", volume=1)]
[CameraShake(duration=2, xstrength=60, ystrength=60, vibrato=20, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[delay(time=4)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1072_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="Logos"]——
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1072_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="Logos"]阿斯卡纶！
[charslot]
[dialog]
[charslot]
[Blocker(a=0.6, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="在昏迷的前一秒，你看见阿斯卡纶抱住了阿米娅，而Logos则挡在了你的面前。", x=300,y=270,  alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n你看到石像复苏。",block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="\n你看到赦罪师眯起的眼，你看到她率先敲响丧钟。",block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1")]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[dialog]
[PlaySound(key="$d_sp_ballista",volume=1.0)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_explosion", volume=0.9)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_rockfall")]
[CameraShake(duration=4, xstrength=40,ystrength=40, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]

[Blocker(a=1, r=255, g=255, b=255, fadetime=0.05, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=255, g=255, b=255, fadetime=0.05, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=1, r=255, g=255, b=255, fadetime=0.05, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=255, g=255, b=255, fadetime=0.05, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=2, block=false)]

[Decision(options="——！", values="1")]
[Predicate(references="1")]
[playMusic(intro="$darkness01_intro", key="$darkness01_loop", volume=0.6)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1072_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="Logos"]博士。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1072_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="Logos"]我们已经离开了洞窟，阿斯卡纶在勘察附近的地形。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1072_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="Logos"]你的右臂桡骨被折断了，我正在为你做最基础的处理。我不是医疗干员，只能做到这个程度。
[dialog]
[charslot]
[Decision(options="阿米娅的情况怎么样？", values="1")]
[Predicate(references="1")]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1072_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="Logos"]……她还在昏迷。“受困于众魂”，尽管赦罪师表露出类似含义，但……
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1072_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="Logos"]至少，她性命无碍。
[charslot]
[dialog]
[Blocker(a=0.6, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[Sticker(id="st1", multi = true, text="你扭过头，卡特斯女孩安静地躺在树下，好像只是睡着了一般。", x=300,y=270,  alignment="left", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700,block = true)]
[Sticker(id="st1")]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1072_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="Logos"]我理解阿斯卡纶对你行事的不满，博士。她所担心的，不仅有你的安全。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1072_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="Logos"]但你确实为我们争取了时间，如果不是你的拖延，赦罪师恐怕已经带着阿米娅躲藏进了伦蒂尼姆的高墙之后。
[dialog]
[charslot]
[Decision(options="那个赦罪师呢？", values="1")]
[Predicate(references="1")]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1072_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="Logos"]让她逃了。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1072_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="Logos"]土石，鲜血，还有……女妖之啸。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1072_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="Logos"]这就是赦罪师所期望的萨卡兹的模样？执迷于……所谓的血统和巫术？
[dialog]
[charslot]
[Decision(options="他们的目标是“魔王”。", values="1")]
[Predicate(references="1")]
[Decision(options="我们必须尽快转告凯尔希和闪灵。", values="1")]
[Predicate(references="1")]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1072_1#5$1",focus="m")]
[name="Logos"]……等等。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1072_1#5$1",focus="m")]
[name="Logos"]这些氤氲的水汽……
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1072_1#5$1",focus="m")]
[name="Logos"]……不可能。博士，小心些。我们未必离开了敌人的陷阱。
[dialog]
[charslot]
[Decision(options="怎么了？;很少见你的脸色变化。", values="1;2")]
[Predicate(references="1;2")]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1072_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="Logos"]这里……不是维多利亚。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1072_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="Logos"]这里是女妖的河谷。
